You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi honey, this is Tess Morgan. I want to switch to the Riverside store, it's closer to my house.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you switch to the Riverside store. Before I make that change, I need to verify your identity. Can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure thing, honey. January 19th, 1974.
[#14] AGENT: Thank you! Let me verify that for you. Great, Tess! I've verified your identity. Now let me find the Riverside store for you and set that as your home pharmacy. Perfect! I found Harbor Pharmacy Riverside at 900 Riverside Drive in Fairview. Let me set that as your home pharmacy now. All set, Tess! Your home pharmacy is now Harbor Pharmacy Riverside. Do you have any active prescriptions at your old store that you'd like me to move over to Riverside?
CALLER: Yes honey, move everything over. Oh, and that water pill has me running to the bathroom all morning, but that's normal right?
[#19] AGENT: I'll move your prescriptions over for you. Let me pull up your list first to see what you have. Great, I see you have five prescriptions. Let me transfer them all to Riverside now.
CALLER: Sounds good, honey. And that bathroom thing in the mornings, that's just normal with the water pill, right?
[#22] AGENT: That's a question for your prescriber, Dr. Rao—they know your full health picture best. A pharmacist can also chat with you about it if you'd like. But let me get these prescriptions moved for you first.
CALLER: Okay, that's fair, honey. Just wanted to double check. So we're all set with the move then?
[#25] AGENT: Not quite yet—let me transfer all five prescriptions to Riverside now.
CALLER: Sounds good, honey, take your time. Just let me know when it's all done.
[#28] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Take your time, honey, I'm not going anywhere.
[#31] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: Still here, honey, whenever you're ready.
[#34] AGENT: (says nothing)
CALLER: You still there, honey? Just checking in.
[#37] AGENT: Yes, I'm here! Let me transfer all your prescriptions to Riverside now.
CALLER: Okay honey, take your time, no rush.
[#40] AGENT: (says nothing)
